subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity mapping exercise, exec readiness & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Porter <anna.porter@altair.ai>, Procurement <procurement@altair.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity mapping exercise, exec readiness & QBR scheduling

Hi Anna / Altair procurement team —

Thanks for confirming a renewal conversation window. Per our pre-call, I wanted to kick off the formal renewal thread so we can align on the timeline, stakeholder list, and a short capacity-mapping exercise to validate the uplift path. High-level asks from Redwood: 

- Confirm the list of internal stakeholders who should attend the QBR (technical lead, procurement, and an exec sponsor).
- Share a recent 7/30/90-day usage snapshot and any forecasted burst windows (CSV preferred).
- Confirm whether you plan to request any SLA or term changes (targeting 12 vs 24 months, seat v. throughput changes).

Proposed timelines: 
- Week of Mar 22: Quick intake call (30m) to review usage and MAP (mutual action plan).
- Week of Mar 29: Draft amendment and QBR (1h) with execs to review recommended throughput and pricing ladder.

QBR windows I have open (PST): Mar 29 10:00–11:00, Mar 30 14:00–15:00. If those don't work, propose two alternatives.

I attached a lightweight QBR agenda (draft) and a MAP template to speed kickoff. For the capacity mapping, the key fields we need are: average tokens/day, peak % uplift, concurrent request distribution by hour, and top-3 latency-sensitive routes.

If you prefer, we can run a short correlational readout (15m) ahead of the intake call to validate numbers — happy to involve Laura (onsite architect) and Marissa (Customer Success) on that.

Next steps: Anna, can you share the usage snapshot by EOD Friday and confirm a preferred intake window?

Thanks —

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_agenda_draft.pdf, MAP-template.xlsx
From: Anna Porter <anna.porter@altair.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@altair.ai>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@altair.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity mapping exercise, exec readiness & QBR scheduling

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear note. We're ready to move. I've looped Diego (Head of ML Ops) and procurement in this thread. Diego will own the technical numbers; procurement will handle PO/timing.

We attached a 90-day snapshot (Altair_capacity_snapshot_Q1.csv). Quick context:
- Baseline tokens/day: ~42M (rolling average)
- Expected holiday/big-campaign bump in June: +220% peak for ~48 hours
- Concurrent p95 requests currently ~62; anticipated commit target is to double sustained throughput over the next 12 months.

We prefer a one-hour intake on Mar 23 at 14:00 PST. That works best for Diego and our procurement lead. For the QBR, Mar 30 14:00 PST is preferred.

Term preference: we are leaning toward a 24-month term if we can secure a graduated discount ladder tied to commit tiers. Also interested in an SLA uplift for sustained 99.9% token delivery during peak windows—will need a short exec-level justification for internal signoff.

I'll bring a short slide with the business justification and invite Diego to provide a two-minute technical readout.

Best,
Anna Porter
VP Growth Operations, Altair AI
anna.porter@altair.ai

Attachments: Altair_capacity_snapshot_Q1.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal kickoff: capacity mapping exercise, exec readiness & QBR scheduling

Forwarding Anna's reply — good detail. Quick internal notes / proposed owners: 

- Intake call (Mar 23 14:00 PST): Jonas (AE) lead, Laura (Technical Architect) to review capacity mapping, Marissa (CS) to present onboarding/staffing plan.
- Prep work: Marissa to draft the mutual action plan (MAP-template.xlsx) with milestone owners and internal gating items. Jonas to own pricing ladder and contract amendment draft.
- SLA request: I'll coordinate with Reliability on feasibility and prepare an "exec readiness" one-pager outlining compensating controls (fallback model variants, cross-region routing).

Action items (internal):
1) Marissa: Prepare a draft MAP with milestones by EOD Mon Mar 21.
2) Laura: Review Altair CSV and outline potential autoscale/burst approaches by Mon Mar 21.
3) Jonas: Start a redline for a 24-month term + graduated discount and share by Tue Mar 22.

We'll keep this thread for external-facing comms; use the MAP doc for internal coordination and link the HubSpot deal (ALT-2023-045).

-Laura

——
Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Anna / Diego / procurement —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the snapshot — very helpful. Confirmed items and next steps below: 

1) Intake call: Mar 23, 14:00–14:30 PST (30 min) — we'll do a tight capacity readout. I will send a calendar invite with the MAP attached.
2) QBR + exec review: Mar 30, 14:00–15:00 PST — target to review pricing ladder, redline, and SLA ask. I will bring the 24-month amendment draft and the graduated discount tiers.
3) Deliverables before intake:
   - Altair: share any additional surge windows beyond June (if uncertain, a best-effort list).
   - Redwood: Laura to send a short note on autoscale/burst approaches; Marissa will attach a preliminary staffing ramp and onboarding timeline.

4) Legal / procurement path: Jonas to open a preliminary DocuSign amendment (covering term change and commit tiers) after the QBR; procurement, please confirm if your preferred signature authority is a PO or DocuSign contract.

5) Exec readiness: Laura and Grace will prepare an \"Exec checklist\" that includes the business impact (cost delta at peak), operational mitigations (fallback variants, region failover), and a short runbook for an anticipated 48-hour spike.

If procurement needs any specific docs (SOC2 evidence, KMS attestation) ahead of PO review, drop a short list into this thread and Grace will route to Security.

I'll circulate calendar invites in the next 30 minutes and add the HubSpot link to the invite notes. Thanks — looking forward to a smooth renewal.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
